title: The PS2 Lighthouse Game That Counts One Boat Too Many
description:
A logbook page was left on my doorstep. Wrapped inside: an unreleased PS2 lighthouse keeper game called LAMPLIGHT. One rule: count the boats on every sweep. If there is one more than you counted, put the light out. On the second night, the beam found a ninth lamp on the lake, and the counter refused to count it.

An original PS2-era survival horror story from Dead Pixel Studios, the studio that never released a single game. Lost media, a haunted video game, an empty rowing boat that keeps coming closer, and the map file that connects every Dead Pixel game. If you know anything about Merrow Lake, tell me in the comments.
